facts.fact: The Fifth Board of the Network of African Data Protection Authorities, comprising the authorities of Cabo Verde, Cote d'Ivoire and Zimbabwe, signed a declaration proclaiming 21 September as Africa Data Protection Day on 3 September 2026, so Cabo Verde holds a seat on the board (a Zimbabwe regulator official says so, LinkedIn, 2026-09-04).
